visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair in a high ponytail, wearing a white lacy top and an off-white coat, stands in a brightly colored lottery store. She smiles at the camera while holding a 1000 NTD bill. The background is filled with yellow and red lottery signage and displays. (2) She holds a pink smartphone in front of her face, appearing to record or use a voice assistant. Her expression shifts from curiosity to slight frustration. A small circular portrait of a man wearing glasses appears as a brief overlay on the left side of the screen. (3) The woman is sitting at a bright yellow counter. She uses a coin to scratch several red and gold lottery tickets. Close-up shots show the physical texture of the scratch-off surface and the numbers revealed beneath. (4) She holds up a larger red scratch-off ticket titled '1200萬大吉利' and smiles broadly at the camera. She is leaning on the counter in a casual posture, gesturing toward the ticket as she talks. (5) Various on-screen text overlays and graphic frames surround her as she continues her energetic presentation, concluding her story about the lottery results.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat electronic pop music kicks in immediately. A female voice speaks with high pitch and fast tempo, introducing the lottery challenge. The background noise is minimal, suggesting a clean field recording. (2) Sounds of a phone's voice assistant interface are audible. The female speaker's tone becomes slightly more assertive and frustrated as she interacts with the AI. The music remains steady in the background. (3) Distinct rhythmic scratching sounds create high-frequency transients. A male off-camera voice enters, speaking in a calm, conversational manner. The female speaker responds with laughter and a humorous tone. (4) Digital UI 'ding' sound effects punctuate the revealing of numbers. The female voice exhibits higher arousal and joy, speaking with an excited, rising intonation pattern. (5) The music swells slightly in volume during the final scene. The speaker concludes with a cheerful, summarized statement, maintaining a clear and enunciated delivery style.
